datasets.name: headline
datasets.query: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_stage_timings) AS live_sessions, (SELECT count(*) FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_live_mistakes WHERE repair_id = 'rk61_switch_replacement' AND length(trim(mistake)) > 0) AS mistakes_caught, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT step_index, lower(trim(mistake)) AS m FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_live_mistakes WHERE repair_id = 'rk61_switch_replacement' AND length(trim(mistake)) > 0 GROUP BY step_index, lower(trim(mistake)) HAVING count(DISTINCT session_id) >= 2)) AS warnings_learned

datasets.name: stuck
datasets.query: WITH m AS (SELECT step_index, lower(trim(mistake)) AS mistake, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, count(*) AS times_seen, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_live_mistakes WHERE repair_id = 'rk61_switch_replacement' AND length(trim(mistake)) > 0 GROUP BY step_index, lower(trim(mistake))), s AS (SELECT step_index, min(instruction) AS instruction FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.gold_procedure_steps WHERE repair_id = 'rk61_switch_replacement' AND source_kind = 'canonical' GROUP BY step_index) SELECT concat('Step ', m.step_index, ': ', coalesce(left(s.instruction, 48), '')) AS step, m.step_index, m.mistake, m.sessions, m.times_seen, m.last_seen, CASE WHEN m.sessions >= 2 THEN 'Now a warning for the next person' ELSE 'Seen in one session so far' END AS status FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.step_index = m.step_index ORDER BY m.sessions DESC, m.times_seen DESC

datasets.name: impact
datasets.query: SELECT count(*) AS repairs_recommended, round(sum(savings), 2) AS money_saved, round(sum(ewaste_kg_avoided), 2) AS ewaste_kg_avoided FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_part_cards WHERE verdict = 'repair' AND NOT is_mock

datasets.name: decisions
datasets.query: SELECT concat(brand, ' ', model) AS device, part_needed AS part, repair_cost, new_price, savings, ewaste_kg_avoided, substr(searched_at, 1, 16) AS decided_at FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_part_cards WHERE verdict = 'repair' AND NOT is_mock ORDER BY searched_at DESC

datasets.name: parts
datasets.query: SELECT part_needed AS part, retailer, price, currency, independent_sources AS sources, CASE WHEN verified THEN 'Fits, verified' ELSE 'Fits, unverified' END AS compatibility, url FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.gold_part_prices WHERE lower(model) LIKE '%rk61%' ORDER BY part, rank_in_card

datasets.name: latency
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT stage, 'typical (p50)' AS percentile, round(percentile_approx(ms, 0.5), 0) AS ms, count(*) AS samples FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_stage_timings WHERE ok GROUP BY stage UNION ALL SELECT stage, 'slow (p90)' AS percentile, round(percentile_approx(ms, 0.9), 0) AS ms, count(*) AS samples FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.bronze_stage_timings WHERE ok GROUP BY stage) ORDER BY ms DESC

datasets.name: kb
datasets.query: SELECT CASE source_kind WHEN 'canonical' THEN 'Final procedure' WHEN 'video' THEN 'Repair videos' WHEN 'web' THEN 'Web guides' WHEN 'manual' THEN 'Manuals' ELSE source_kind END AS source, steps, procedures FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.gold_kb_coverage WHERE repair_id = 'rk61_switch_replacement' ORDER BY steps DESC

datasets.name: eval_quality
datasets.query: SELECT CASE backend WHEN 'adaption' THEN 'Adaption fine-tune' WHEN 'claude' THEN 'Claude Haiku' ELSE backend END AS model, CASE metric WHEN 'accuracy' THEN 'Step accuracy' WHEN 'mistake_recall' THEN 'Mistakes caught' ELSE metric END AS metric, round(value, 3) AS value, n FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.gold_eval_scoreboard WHERE eval_name = 'step_tracker' AND metric IN ('accuracy', 'mistake_recall') ORDER BY metric, backend

datasets.name: eval_latency
datasets.query: SELECT CASE backend WHEN 'adaption' THEN 'Adaption fine-tune' WHEN 'claude' THEN 'Claude Haiku' ELSE backend END AS model, round(value, 0) AS latency_ms, n FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.gold_eval_scoreboard WHERE eval_name = 'step_tracker' AND metric = 'latency_p50_ms' ORDER BY backend

widget.name: intro
widget.textbox_spec:
# Spanner learns from every repair

Each live session writes what the camera saw and where the person went wrong. A mistake seen in two or more sessions becomes a warning the next person hears before they reach that step. The data below is written by the live app, not loaded for the demo.

x.displayName: Sessions where someone got it wrong

frame.title: Where people get stuck
frame.description: One bar per step of the RK61 switch replacement. Sessions, not frames: the same mistake repeated in one session counts once.

frame.title: Warnings now given to the next person
What the next person is warned about, and why
frame.description: The warning is spoken by Spanner when that step opens: "People often put the switch in rotated here."

frame.title: Devices kept out of the bin
Repair or replace: what the Linkup agent decided
frame.description: Cheapest part verified to fit the exact model on two or more independent sites, against the live price of a new unit.

frame.title: Replacement parts for the RK61, with their evidence
frame.description: Found live by the Linkup agent. Every offer is checked against the model on independent pages before it is shown to the user.

frame.title: How long each live decision takes
frame.description: Measured in the running app. "coach" is one webcam frame in, step and mistake out.

frame.title: What the procedure was built from
frame.description: Repair videos watched by Gemini, web guides found with Tavily, written into one procedure by Claude, quality-checked by the Lakeflow pipeline.

frame.title: Step judge: Adaption fine-tune against Claude Haiku
frame.description: On held-out frames from real repair sessions. Empty until the evaluation has run.
